introductionBio: I am a Software Engineer with a strong background in Full-Stack development, specializing in Backend Architecture and system scalability. I am passionate about modernizing legacy systems and designing solutions that drive operational efficiency.
bio:
I am a Software Engineer specializing in Full-Stack development and System Architecture, with solid experience since 2017 developing scalable, high-performance solutions for the oil & gas and logistics sectors.
I have advanced expertise in Java (Spring Boot), JavaScript/TypeScript (Node, React), and SQL. My experience includes modernizing legacy systems and designing microservices architectures, leveraging technologies like Docker, Kubernetes, and PostgreSQL to build robust and efficient environments.

experience.title: Intelie
experience.description:
Acted as interim technical lead during manager's leave, owning corporate stakeholder relationships and co-driving product roadmap prioritization alongside senior leadership — while sustaining full senior engineering responsibilities.
Drove the client-reported ticket backlog from 24 to 3 open issues within weeks, restoring SLA health through the leadership transition.
Serve as primary technical point of contact for a flagship enterprise client in the oil & gas sector, running recurring discovery sessions to translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.
Re-architected server-side call orchestration, cutting active instances from 2,000+ to under 150 while preserving full functional coverage — eliminating server overload risk and infrastructure overhead.
Led standardization of WITSML, an industry-standard oil & gas data-interchange protocol, aligning data ingestion with sector-wide interoperability requirements.
